user.title: Connect CompTrol ZLT
user.description: Enter the address of the S-Klima CompTrol ZLT and a user of its web interface. Tip: create a dedicated user for Home Assistant in Konfig. → Benutzerverwaltung.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the CompTrol ZLT, e.g. 192.168.1.50

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to CompTrol ZLT again
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {host} are no longer accepted. Enter them again.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the CompTrol ZLT. Check the address and that Home Assistant can reach this network (firewall/VLAN).
error.invalid_auth: User name or password is wrong, or the user is not active.
error.invalid_characters: User name and password must not contain an apostrophe (').
error.encryption_unsupported: This CompTrol ZLT uses encrypted requests, which this integration does not support yet.
error.no_units: Login worked, but no indoor units were found.

abort.already_configured: This CompTrol ZLT is already configured.
